title: Weakly associated primes detect the zero divisors of a ring
statement: Let A be a commutative ring [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Define WeakAss(A) to be the set of prime ideals that are minimal over the annihilator of some element of A. Then the set of zero-divisors of A is the union of the primes in WeakAss(A); equivalently, the complement of the union of WeakAss(A) is the set of non-zero-divisors of A.
